capabilities: define scripts as Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter and parameter schemas
validate required parameters, types and constraints before spawning processes
run scripts via stdin, CLI args or temp files with streaming output and a stop button
expose scripts as MCP tools for AI agents
install starter vault-maintenance scripts such as broken-link and backup scripts
disambiguation: Not an AI assistant or model runner; it manages and executes local automation scripts that AI agents can invoke as tools.
extras: Starter scripts ship with pt-BR guides and require python on the PATH; a setting to allow writing outside the vault exists but is not enforced yet.
problem: Obsidian offers no safe, structured way to define, validate and execute local scripts that AI agents can call, with process control and secret handling.

relations.evidence: The AI Ecosystem core can install Claude Code hooks and a setup skill for this module
and a block in GEMINI.md for Antigravity

requires.name: AI agent client such as Claude Code for hooks and MCP tools

summary: Script manager that stores automation scripts as Markdown notes with validated parameters and runs them for AI agents with streaming terminal output.
